purpose: Select equal-area cross-Smith quotient pairs whose H4/H8/H12 character fingerprints are maximally separated per measured CPU cost.

model.nuisance_parameter_in_score: one shared amplitude per harmonic model
model.model_vector: DeltaM_N = A_s * N^(-13/8) * Delta cos(s theta)

existing_P205_limitation.reason: N325/N425 each supplied only one affine-null coordinate, the raw M noise scale was comparable to the fixed-model residuals, and all three harmonics survived. The character prism adds orthogonal sign flips instead of only shrinking the same covariance.

minimal_sufficient_statistics.per_pair: For each synchronized batch and each orientation, the marginal K_plus and K_minus threshold-rank histograms, or equivalently the two fixed-p M values after a frozen binomial transform.
minimal_sufficient_statistics.covariance: Common priority field within each equal-N pair; independent seeds across N25/N50/N125; one 3-vector covariance is therefore diagonal across sizes after the within-pair DeltaM construction.
